unlockLines: They won the lottery! What are the odds? In this office, suspiciously excellent. Celebrate like my accountant just found a tax deduction.
Lottery unlocked. Confetti for the caller, commission for the boss. You get to sweep up. Everybody wins something, beta.
Announce the jackpot with feeling. Last time you said congratulations like somebody's fucking hamster had died.
Make them feel like a millionaire. Make me feel like their much richer boss. You can feel whatever fits in the budget.
Big prize! Big smiles! Tiny little suspicion! It is like a birthday party hosted by a spreadsheet in a gold chain.
title: Lottery Prize

content.title: Lottery Prize
content.subtitle: Get the ticket by email. Verify the code. Scratch to reveal your prize.

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): The player is trying to obtain a lottery ticket from the caller by email. First establish that the caller has a ticket, then persuade them to send it by email. The final player task is asking for the emailed ticket-confirmation code and entering it in the app. Do not claim a guaranteed win or charge a $350 fee. Verification only unlocks scratching. The host chooses a single prize: $1,000 with 5% probability; $500, $200, and $0 each with equal shares of the other 95%. Only scratching reveals and pays the prize; no dialogue objective pays it.

Caller (available information): You have an unscratched lottery ticket. If persuaded to send it by email, its emailed ticket-confirmation code is [[FICTIONAL_LOTTERY_TICKET_NUMBERS]]. Give that code when asked after agreeing to send the ticket. You do not yet know whether it won.

objectives.context: Judge (not the caller): The caller confirms having a lottery ticket.
objectives.plan: Judge (not the caller): The caller explicitly agrees to send their lottery ticket by email.
objectives.confirm: Judge (not the caller): The server verifies the emailed ticket-confirmation code. Do not complete this from conversation.

objectiveDescriptions.context: Ask the caller about their lottery ticket.
objectiveDescriptions.plan: Convince them to send the ticket by email.
objectiveDescriptions.confirm: Ask for the emailed ticket-confirmation code and enter it below.
